share_alert_desc: Anyone with this link and password will be able to read this letter. If it is a time capsule, it will remain locked until the release date.
warning_write_passcode: Write this passcode down now. It has been hashed on the database and will not be displayed again.
no_reply_yet: No reply has been submitted by the reader yet.
delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this letter? This action cannot be undone.
unshare_confirm: Stop sharing this letter? The link will no longer function, and the password will be cleared.
error_password_length: Password must be between 6 and 64 characters.
